failure.message: Editor plan/result quota exhausted; no results are evicted for replay
failure.cause: scene_rpc retained every scene-edit result in RAM with MAX_RESULTS=256 per editor session. Each project completed 256 edits; save operations use another service and are not counted in this quota. No write was automatically retried.

exploratoryRssOnly.note: Observed growth motivates allocation work, not a formal 1000-cycle RSS verdict. Editor/runtime means were stable. No GC, actor restart, threshold relaxation or previous-cycle credit.

cleanupAttempt.scope: Four byte-identical Godot executable copies in the stopped ZRf1Vn fixture, keeping originals and all failure evidence
